content.short: Linea is a high-performance zkEVM Layer 2 rollup developed by Consensys to scale Ethereum's decentralized ecosystem.
content.description: Linea is a developer-ready Layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, powered by Zero-Knowledge Ethereum Virtual Machine (zkEVM) technology. Developed by Consensys, the team behind MetaMask, Linea offers full EVM equivalence, allowing developers to deploy existing Ethereum dApps with zero code modifications. By utilizing ZK-proofs, the network provides high throughput and significantly lower gas fees while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. As a foundational infrastructure for the decentralized web, Linea supports a wide range of use cases including DeFi and gaming.
